title: Our tone
slide_intent: Translate four abstract traits into editing actions that affect how a visitor hears a sentence.
strategic_value: Concrete tests can help many writers produce a recognizable voice while leaving room for humor, questions and other people’s words.
demonstration: Four parallel columns label Engaging, Curious, Enjoyable and Respectful. Each combines an explanation with green practical tips.
practical_value: Read a sentence aloud, try an active construction and check the attribution or suggested edits when quoting another speaker.

content_islands.name: Engaging and Curious
content_islands.spec: Place everyday-language and active-sentence guidance in the first two columns. Distinguish the tips in green.

content_islands.name: Enjoyable and Respectful
content_islands.spec: Use the next columns for direct address, contemporary phrasing, respect for quoted voices and care when editing them.
